meta.source: Design brief v2 (2026-10-10), section 7 current values, evolved as Concept A

tokens.name: surface-body
tokens.usage: Page background behind the board and panels. Source value, unchanged.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Top bar, setup panel, bench panel, transport bar. Source value, unchanged.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, role picker, tooltips, phone sheets. New: lifts floating layers off surface-panel.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between panel sections. Not for control edges (below 3:1).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of fields, segmented controls and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on surface-body, surface-panel and surface-raised in both themes. New.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and labels on surface-body, surface-panel and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, summaries, counts on surface-body, surface-panel and surface-raised. Light value darkened from #706e65 (was 4.25:1 on surface-panel, now 5.01:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The orange. Primary button fill, selected zone, active phase dot, active setup step. Source value, unchanged.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for accent. Light value changed from #b8672f so accent-text still clears 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover. Light changed from #ffffff (3.43:1, failed AA) to ink (5.42:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Orange used as text or an icon on surface-body, surface-panel and surface-raised (links, the current-role mark). New: accent itself is 3.12:1 on cream.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Fill of the ink button (Share, Play) and selected segment. Source value.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for control.

tokens.name: control-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on control and control-hover.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px offset, on every surface and on the pitch. At least 3:1 on all of them. New.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error banner icon, title and edge; error copy on surface-panel, surface-raised and error-surface.

tokens.name: error-surface
tokens.usage: Error banner fill. text and error both clear 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info banner icon and edge; info copy on surface-panel and info-surface.

tokens.name: info-surface
tokens.usage: Info banner fill (saved boards skipped, storage unavailable).

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: Pitch grass and zone-map cells. Source value, unchanged.

tokens.name: pitch-stripe
tokens.usage: Alternate mowing bands on the pitch, 10 bands top to bottom. Source value.

tokens.name: pitch-line
tokens.usage: Pitch markings and zone-map grid lines, 0.4 unit stroke. Source value (72% white).

tokens.name: pitch-label-plate
tokens.usage: Solid plate behind role names and the Finish setting up your tactic label on the pitch, so labels hold 4.5:1 on any mowing band. New.

tokens.name: pitch-label-text
tokens.usage: Role names and pitch labels on pitch-label-plate (10:1 and above).

tokens.name: zone-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered zone-map cell. New.

tokens.name: zone-selected
tokens.usage: Selected zone-map cell fill.

tokens.name: team-mine
tokens.usage: My team's outfield token fill. Light is the source value; dark shifted lighter from #1c3d6e so the disc reads as blue on the dark pitch. Always drawn with token-ring.

tokens.name: team-mine-text
tokens.usage: Position label on team-mine (10.81:1 light, 7.43:1 dark).

tokens.name: team-mine-keeper
tokens.usage: My keeper's token fill. Source value.

tokens.name: team-mine-keeper-text
tokens.usage: Label on team-mine-keeper. Changed from white (3.03:1) to ink (6.15:1).

tokens.name: team-opp
tokens.usage: Opponent outfield token fill. Light is the source value; dark shifted lighter from #7a1c2e (1.01:1 on the dark pitch). Always drawn with token-ring.

tokens.name: team-opp-text
tokens.usage: Position label on team-opp (10.33:1 light, 6.43:1 dark).

tokens.name: team-opp-keeper
tokens.usage: Opponent keeper fill. Dark shifted lighter from #4a2f7a.

tokens.name: team-opp-keeper-text
tokens.usage: Label on team-opp-keeper.

tokens.name: token-ring
tokens.usage: 2px ring around every token. This ring, not the fill, carries the 3:1 edge against the pitch (5.12:1 light, 9.78:1 dark).

tokens.name: token-selected
tokens.usage: Outer 2px halo on a selected or carrier-picked token, outside token-ring.

tokens.name: ball
tokens.usage: The ball's white panels.

tokens.name: ball-ring
tokens.usage: The ball's black panels, seams and edge (classic black-and-white football).

tokens.name: arrow
tokens.usage: Movement arrows and target rings for both teams. My team solid, opponent dashed, so they are told apart without colour.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: First-run title and the PNG export header. Desktop only; use title-1 on phones.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Team names over the board, dialog titles on phones.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Dialog titles, setup step titles, role picker heading.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels: setup step counter, bench heading, zone map heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tap a zone on the map.
styles.usage: Default UI copy, dialog body, role descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The current zone name, selected list items.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, toggles, field labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Step summaries, tooltips, slot meta, banner body.

styles.name: role-name
styles.usage: Role name under a token, two lines at most, on pitch-label-plate. Rendered at 1.5 pitch units; never below 11px on screen.

styles.name: position
styles.usage: Position label on a token (DM, D(C), AM(L)). Rendered at 1.6 pitch units.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Squad counts, character counters, slot numbers.

styles.name: phase
styles.usage: Phase dot labels in the transport bar, uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, token label offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between grouped buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between panel sections, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between the board and side panels on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Outer page margin on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Label plates, zone-map cells, tooltips, inputs' inner corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, list items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, the role picker, the pitch frame.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Phase dots, toggles, pill badges.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, role picker, tooltips, sheets. Panels on the page use borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: A token while it is dragged.

duration.note: Motion durations. Components read them as CSS custom properties.

tokens.name: duration-phase
tokens.usage: Tween between Shape, Runs and Final, and into the zone shape when a zone is picked. Spike value, to be adjusted.

tokens.name: duration-cadence
tokens.usage: Wait between phases while Play runs. Spike value, to be adjusted.

tokens.name: duration-piece
tokens.usage: Any piece move that is not a phase step: drop, bench and unbench, undo, redo, reset, clear, applying a formation or matchup, loading a tactic or link, pass, dribble.

tokens.name: duration-ui
tokens.usage: Hover, press, tooltip and segment changes.

tokens.name: duration-reduced
tokens.usage: With prefers-reduced-motion: every piece movement uses this short ease-out instead of the durations above. Pieces still travel; they never jump (motion law).

size.note: Fixed sizes for touch and the board.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target on phones, including token hit areas.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and fields on desktop. Phones use tap-min.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Phone breakpoint: a viewport this wide or narrower is a phone (provisional, O-11). The only breakpoint.

tokens.name: pitch-ratio
tokens.usage: Pitch width over height (76.19 by 100 units). Vertical; the attacking team plays up.
